speaker: Daniel
text: I’ve been irritated and perplexed many times - not speaking a language, not understanding or being understood. Once, in Italy, a hotel clerk tried to overcharge me and only gave up after 10 minutes of arguing. Another time in India, a taxi driver insisted I pay more, and I was rescued by the doorman of a fancy hotel.
